name: Mesa Verde National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets may use roads and paved areas, and some paved trails at Wetherill Mesa, but not trails or sites.
summary: Leashed pets may use roads and paved areas on Mesa Top Loop and Park Point, and Wetherill Mesa trails except Step House and Long House.

excerpts.quote: If hiking with your pet at Wetherill, consider not only the air temperature but also the temperature of the paved trails.
At Wetherill Mesa, pets are permitted on all trails except for the trails leading into Step House and Long House.
Leashed pets are allowed on roads, parking lots, and paved areas on Mesa Top Loop and Park Point but not on trails, in ancestral sites or buildings.

dogRules.text: Roads, parking lots and paved areas on Mesa Top Loop and Park Point only.
Mesa Top Loop and Park Point: not on trails, in ancestral sites or buildings.
Wetherill Mesa: all trails allowed except those into Step House and Long House.
